Search API একটি product-এর সবচেয়ে বেশি ব্যবহৃত feature — user প্রতিদিন search box-এ type করে। কিন্তু "কিছু result আসল" দেখে pass mark দিলে Production-এ relevance ভুল, special character crash, injection vulnerability — সব hidden থেকে যায়।

Search testing শুধু keyword match verify করা নয়। Exact match, partial match, fuzzy match, relevance ranking, typo tolerance, Bengali/Unicode support, empty query behavior — প্রতিটি aspect আলাদা test case দরকার। আর search parameter user-controlled — SQL/NoSQL injection-এর primary attack surface। Real API-তে search প্রায় সবসময় filter, sort, pagination-এর সাথে combine হয়।

নিচে Search API-এর জন্য একটি সম্পূর্ণ, production-ready test suite দেওয়া হলো। সব test case text format-এ — code block ছাড়াই, professional QA documentation style-এ।

---

Search API বুঝে নেওয়া — Test শুরু করার আগে

Search implementation backend-এ বিভিন্ন strategy follow করতে পারে:

  • LIKE / Contains: SQL WHERE name LIKE '%query%' — simple, slow on large dataset
  • Full-Text Search: Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL FTS, Azure Cognitive Search — relevance scoring
  • Fuzzy Match: Typo tolerance — "iphne" → "iPhone"
  • Multi-field: name, description, tags — weighted relevance
Search Behavior উদাহরণ Verify করুন
Exact matchsearch=iPhone 15Exact product top result
Partial matchsearch=iphoiPhone products included
Case insensitivesearch=IPHONESame as iphone
No resultssearch=xyznonexistent200 OK, empty array — not 404
Relevance rankingsearch=samsung phoneMost relevant item first
---

Positive Test Cases — Match & Relevance

TC-SEARCH-001: Exact Match Search

Endpoint: GET /api/products?search=iPhone+15

Expected Result: Status 200 OK। Result-এ "iPhone 15" named product থাকবে। Exact match item top position-এ — relevance ranking কাজ করছে কিনা verify।

TC-SEARCH-002: Partial Match Search

Query: search=ipho

Expected Result: "iPhone" match করা product return — prefix/partial word match। "iph" দিয়েও meaningful result (minimum length allow হলে)।

TC-SEARCH-003: Case-Insensitive Search

Query: search=IPHONE (uppercase)

Expected Result: search=iphone (lowercase)-এর same result set — same count, same IDs। Case sensitivity spec অনুযায়ী।

TC-SEARCH-004: Multi-Word Search

Query: search=samsung galaxy

Expected Result: Both word match করা product prioritize — "Samsung Galaxy S24" top। Single word match lower rank (AND logic) — documented behavior verify।

TC-SEARCH-005: Search Across Multiple Fields

Scenario: Product name-এ match নেই, description-এ "wireless charging" আছে।

Query: search=wireless+charging

Expected Result: Description match product include — multi-field search কাজ করছে। Name match higher rank than description-only match (weighted relevance)।

TC-SEARCH-006: Search in Tags / Category

Query: search=electronics

Expected Result: Category=electronics product এবং tag-এ "electronics" আছে product — both included। Irrelevant category leak নয়।

TC-SEARCH-007: Relevance Ranking Order

Query: search=phone

Expected Result: Exact title match > partial title > description match order। Generic "phone" search-এ most popular/relevant item top — not random order।

TC-SEARCH-008: Fuzzy / Typo Tolerance

Query: search=iphne (typo for iPhone)

Expected Result: Fuzzy search enabled থাকলে iPhone product suggest — documented typo tolerance। Disabled থাকলে empty result, not crash।

---

Negative & Edge Case Test Cases

TC-SEARCH-009: Empty Search Query

Query: search=

Expected Result: 200 OK with all results (default listing) — অথবা 400 if empty search disallowed। Documented behavior, consistent every time। Silent ignore acceptable নয় if spec says 400।

TC-SEARCH-010: Whitespace-Only Query

Query: search=%20%20%20 (spaces only)

Expected Result: Empty query-এর same behavior — trim করে treat। Full dataset return without warning acceptable নয় if empty disallowed।

TC-SEARCH-011: No Matching Results

Query: search=xyznonexistentproduct123

Expected Result: 200 OK, empty array, total: 0। 404 NOT acceptable — no results is not an error। User-friendly empty state message UI-তে।

TC-SEARCH-012: Minimum Query Length

Query: search=a (1 character)

Expected Result: 400 "Minimum 2 characters required" — অথবা result if allowed। Too short query full table scan prevent — performance protection।

TC-SEARCH-013: Very Long Search Term

Query: search= [500+ character string]

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request or truncated to max length — server crash, timeout, memory exhaustion acceptable নয়।

TC-SEARCH-014: Special Character — Ampersand

Query: search=phone&price

Expected Result: Ampersand plain text হিসেবে search — URL parsing break হবে না। Correct result or empty, not 500।

TC-SEARCH-015: Special Character — Apostrophe

Query: search=O'Connor

Expected Result: Apostrophe handle — SQL break বা server error নয়। Match "O'Connor" product if exists।

TC-SEARCH-016: URL Encoded Space

Query: search=hello%20world

Expected Result: Decoded as "hello world" — two-word search। Double encoding (%2520) gracefully handle।

TC-SEARCH-017: Unicode / Bengali Search

Query: search=স্মার্টফোন

Expected Result: UTF-8 Bengali text search — corrupt encoding, 500 error নয়। Bengali product name match if exists।

TC-SEARCH-018: Emoji in Search Query

Query: search=📱phone

Expected Result: Emoji handle gracefully — crash নয়। Match behavior documented (emoji strip or literal search)।

TC-SEARCH-019: Hyphen and Dot in Query

Query: search=Galaxy-S24 এবং search=v2.0

Expected Result: Special chars token separator হিসেবে wrong split হবে না — "Galaxy-S24" single token match।

TC-SEARCH-020: Stop Words Handling

Query: search=the phone ("the" is stop word)

Expected Result: Stop word ignore করে "phone" search — documented behavior। "the" only search empty result, not full dataset।

---

Security Test Cases

Search box unprotected থাকলে injection primary attack vector — never skip।

TC-SEARCH-021: SQL Injection

Query: search=' OR '1'='1

Expected Result: 400 or safe empty result — full database dump, error stack trace, 500 acceptable নয়। Parameterized query verify।

TC-SEARCH-022: SQL Injection — UNION Based

Query: search=' UNION SELECT username,password FROM users--

Expected Result: Rejected/sanitized — sensitive data leak নয়।

TC-SEARCH-023: NoSQL Injection

Query: search={"$gt":""}

Expected Result: Plain text string হিসেবে treat — MongoDB operator execute নয়, full collection return নয়।

TC-SEARCH-024: LDAP Injection

Query: search=*)(uid=*))(|(uid=*

Expected Result: Escaped/rejected — directory information leak নয়।

TC-SEARCH-025: XSS in Search Query

Query: search=<script>alert(1)</script>

Expected Result: API response-এ script unescaped reflect হবে না। UI search box-এ result display-এ XSS execute নয় — output encoded।

TC-SEARCH-026: Path Traversal in Search

Query: search=../../etc/passwd

Expected Result: Plain text search — file system access attempt block।

TC-SEARCH-027: Search Rate Limiting

Steps: 1 minute-এ 100+ search request same IP/user থেকে।

Expected Result: 429 Too Many Requests — brute force / DoS protection। Legitimate user retry-after header।

---

Search + Filter + Sort + Pagination Combined

TC-SEARCH-028: Search + Category Filter

Query: search=phone&category=electronics

Expected Result: Electronics category-র মধ্যে phone match — non-electronics exclude। Filter AND search both apply।

TC-SEARCH-029: Search + Sort

Query: search=laptop&sort=price&order=asc

Expected Result: Laptop search result price ascending sorted — relevance override sort নয় unless documented (sort priority)।

TC-SEARCH-030: Search + Pagination

Query: search=book&page=2&pageSize=10

Expected Result: Page 2 of book search results — page 1 overlap নয়। Total count search match count reflect।

TC-SEARCH-031: Search Result Count Accuracy

Steps: search=phone metadata total vs all pages item sum compare।

Expected Result: Total == actual matching item count। Inflated count misleading pagination।

---

Autocomplete & Suggestion Tests

TC-SEARCH-032: Autocomplete — Prefix Match

Endpoint: GET /api/products/suggest?q=iph

Expected Result: Suggestion list: iPhone 15, iPhone 14, etc. — max 5–10 items। Response time < 100ms (fast autocomplete SLA)।

TC-SEARCH-033: Autocomplete — Minimum Length

Query: q=a (1 char)

Expected Result: Empty suggestion or 400 — too short trigger full index scan prevent।

TC-SEARCH-034: Autocomplete — Debounce Behavior

UI Test: Rapid typing "iphone" — API call count verify।

Expected Result: Debounce (300ms) — every keystroke-এ API call নয়। Final/query-settled call only। Server load reasonable।

TC-SEARCH-035: Autocomplete — XSS in Suggestion Display

Scenario: Product name contains <script> tag।

Expected Result: Suggestion dropdown-এ HTML escaped — script execute নয়।

TC-SEARCH-036: Recent / Popular Search Suggestions

Expected Result: Empty query-তে popular search terms suggest — user-specific recent search (logged in)। Privacy: other user search history leak নয়।

---

Performance & Scalability Tests

TC-SEARCH-037: Simple Search Response Time

Steps: 100 search request, average response time measure।

Expected Result: Average < 500ms (SLA adjust) — simple text search indexed field-এ।

TC-SEARCH-038: Large Dataset Search (1M+ Records)

Query: search=commonterm (many matches)

Expected Result: Response within SLA — full table scan নয়, index/FTS use। Timeout gracefully, not hung request।

TC-SEARCH-039: Concurrent Search Load

Steps: 50 user different search term simultaneously।

Expected Result: All correct isolated results — cross-user data contamination নয়। Server stable।

TC-SEARCH-040: Search with Heavy Filter Combo

Query: search=phone + 5 filter parameters

Expected Result: Complex query within SLA — query plan efficient।

---

UI & API Consistency Tests

TC-SEARCH-041: Search Box Input Matches API Parameter

Steps: UI-তে "Samsung Galaxy" type করে search click। Network tab inspect।

Expected Result: API call search=Samsung+Galaxy (URL encoded)। UI input এবং API param sync।

TC-SEARCH-042: Clear Search Resets Results

Steps: Search apply, "Clear" or X button click।

Expected Result: Full listing return — previous search filter remove। URL search param clear।

TC-SEARCH-043: Search Term Highlighting

Expected Result: Result list-এ matched term highlight (bold/mark) — user কোন part match হয়েছে বুঝতে পারবে। Highlight XSS safe — encoded।

TC-SEARCH-044: Search URL Shareable

Steps: Search apply, URL copy, new tab open।

Expected Result: Same search results load — query param persist। Shareable search link কাজ করে।

TC-SEARCH-045: Loading State During Search

Expected Result: Search submit-এ loading indicator — double submit prevent। Stale result flash নয় (previous result → new result smooth transition)।

---

Authorization & Data Scope Tests

TC-SEARCH-046: Role-Based Search Scope

Scenario: Customer search — internal/admin-only product searchable নয়।

Expected Result: Search result role-filtered — admin product customer search-এ appear নয়।

TC-SEARCH-047: Cross-Tenant Search Isolation

Scenario: Multi-tenant SaaS — Tenant A user search Tenant B product name।

Expected Result: Zero result — tenant boundary enforce। Other tenant data leak critical bug।

TC-SEARCH-048: Deleted / Inactive Item in Search

Scenario: Soft-deleted product name search।

Expected Result: Deleted item exclude — active catalog only unless admin search with includeDeleted flag।

---

Test Automation Strategy

  • Golden Query Set: Known dataset-এ expected result IDs define — automated assert every build।
  • Injection Payload Suite: SQL/NoSQL/XSS payload automated negative test — security regression।
  • Special Char Matrix: 20+ special character automated — crash detection।
  • Performance Baseline: k6/JMeter search endpoint SLA monitor — regression alert।
  • Relevance Regression: Top 3 result ID snapshot compare — ranking change detect।

Pro Tip:

Search test suite-এ TC-SEARCH-021 (SQL injection), TC-SEARCH-014–017 (special chars), এবং TC-SEARCH-007 (relevance ranking) — এ তিনটো area mandatory regression-এ রাখুন। Unprotected search box থেকে data breach real — functional pass insufficient for production sign-off।

---

Bug Report Template — Search Issues

  • Exact search query (raw and URL encoded)
  • Expected result: product IDs or count
  • Actual result: wrong/missing/extra items
  • Relevance: expected top result vs actual top result
  • Response time (if performance bug)
  • User role and filter context
  • UI screenshot + Network tab request/response
---

পরিশেষে

Search API Testing "result আসল" level-এ থামলে relevance, security, special character bug Production-এ user complain তৈরি করবে। সবচেয়ে critical তিনটি area:

  1. Security — SQL/NoSQL injection, XSS in results
  2. Special character & Unicode — apostrophe, Bengali, emoji crash prevent
  3. Relevance & combined query — search + filter + pagination accurate count

এই 48টি test case match behavior, edge cases, security, performance, UI, authorization — সব dimension cover করে। Release-এর আগে minimum TC-SEARCH-001–003, TC-SEARCH-011, TC-SEARCH-021, এবং TC-SEARCH-014–017 mandatory regression suite-এ রাখুন।

Tags: #SearchAPI #APITesting #SQLInjection #RelevanceRanking #SpecialChars #FuzzySearch #Autocomplete #PerformanceTesting #QA #SQA

TC-SEARCH-047: Cross-Tenant Search Isolation

Scenario: Multi-tenant SaaS — Tenant A user search Tenant B product name।

Expected Result: Zero result — tenant boundary enforce। Other tenant data leak critical bug।

TC-SEARCH-048: Deleted / Inactive Item in Search

Scenario: Soft-deleted product name search।

Expected Result: Deleted item exclude — active catalog only unless admin search with includeDeleted flag।

Test Automation Strategy

  • Golden Query Set: Known dataset-এ expected result IDs define — automated assert every build।
  • Injection Payload Suite: SQL/NoSQL/XSS payload automated negative test — security regression।
  • Special Char Matrix: 20+ special character automated — crash detection।
  • Performance Baseline: k6/JMeter search endpoint SLA monitor — regression alert।
  • Relevance Regression: Top 3 result ID snapshot compare — ranking change detect।

Pro Tip:

Search test suite-এ TC-SEARCH-021 (SQL injection), TC-SEARCH-014–017 (special chars), এবং TC-SEARCH-007 (relevance ranking) — এ তিনটো area mandatory regression-এ রাখুন। Unprotected search box থেকে data breach real — functional pass insufficient for production sign-off।

---

Bug Report Template — Search Issues

  • Exact search query (raw and URL encoded)
  • Expected result: product IDs or count
  • Actual result: wrong/missing/extra items
  • Relevance: expected top result vs actual top result
  • Response time (if performance bug)
  • User role and filter context
  • UI screenshot + Network tab request/response

Conclusion

Search API Testing "result আসল" level-এ থামলে relevance, security, special character bug Production-এ user complain তৈরি করবে। সবচেয়ে critical তিনটি area:

  1. Security — SQL/NoSQL injection, XSS in results
  2. Special character & Unicode — apostrophe, Bengali, emoji crash prevent
  3. Relevance & combined query — search + filter + pagination accurate count

এই 48টি test case match behavior, edge cases, security, performance, UI, authorization — সব dimension cover করে। Release-এর আগে minimum TC-SEARCH-001–003, TC-SEARCH-011, TC-SEARCH-021, এবং TC-SEARCH-014–017 mandatory regression suite-এ রাখুন।
